title: Turnkey house construction in the Kyiv region: stages and budget
seo_title: Turnkey House Construction: Stages and Budget
description: Turnkey private house construction in the Kyiv region: from design to move-in. Stages, budget components, prices from $600/m², turnkey from $1,100/m².
lead: A house is the biggest investment for most families. We explain how turnkey construction goes from the plot to moving in, what the budget consists of and how to stay within it.
photo_alt: Facade of a 150 m² single-storey house with a carport — House 150 project
body: At CAS Development [house construction](/en/house-construction) starts from $600 per m², and construction with turnkey finishing from $1,100 per m². For a 150 m² turnkey house that is roughly from $165,000. The exact sum is set by the design: wall and roof materials, services, finishing level.

The design gives an accurate estimate and answers the main question — how much the house will cost. Without it a price “per square metre” guarantees nothing: two shells of the same area can differ in price by a factor of two because of materials and services. An architecture and interior design project starts from $30 per m², with a minimum budget of $2,500.

We build single- and two-storey houses, cottages, A-frame houses and holiday resorts in Kyiv and the Kyiv region. One team handles design, construction, finishing and [turnkey procurement](/en/turnkey-procurement).
The plot: what to check before the design
plot boundaries and permitted land use
the possibility of connecting electricity, gas and water
building restrictions and setbacks from boundaries
These data affect the foundation, the position of the house and the services budget. It is better to find them out before the sketch than to redo the design.

Aerated block, ceramic block, timber frame or monolithic solutions differ in price, timing and insulation requirements. We choose the structure to suit the budget, the plot and how the family will live in the house — all year round or seasonally.
Services — the heart of the house

Heating, water supply, drainage, ventilation and electrics in a private house are entirely your responsibility. We build the solutions into the design: boiler type, underfloor heating, heat recovery, backup power. Mistakes in services do not show at once, but they are the most expensive to fix.

During construction you receive photo reports from the site every 1–2 weeks, and payment is made stage by stage. Concealed works — reinforcement, waterproofing, insulation — are recorded before they are closed. This way you see what you are paying for even if you are not on the plot every week.
The warranty on the works is 12 months.

For a 150 m² house the guide is: shell and roof from $90,000 (150 m² × $600), a turnkey house with finishing from $165,000 (150 m² × $1,100). The exact sum depends on the design, wall materials, services and the plot, so we fix the final figure in the estimate after the design.
What to decide at the start
how many storeys and bedrooms the family needs now and in 5–10 years
where the boiler room, wardrobes and pantries will be
whether you need a terrace, a carport, a pool
what the landscape and paths around the house will be like
Answering these questions before the design starts saves money: redoing drawings is cheaper than redoing walls. We also design the landscape around the house — from $50 per 100 m².
faq: How much does a 150 m² turnkey house cost?
From $1,100 per m², so roughly from $165,000. The exact sum is set by the design.
Do you build to someone else's design?
Yes, we will assess the design and draw up an estimate.
Kyiv and the Kyiv region, all regions of Ukraine and Europe. In Europe prices are about 50% higher: shell from $900/m², turnkey from $1,700/m².
